extensionDescription.message: Find skills and subagents while you browse, and install them into Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex.

tabSupportedSitesLink.description: Inline link text inside tabUrlLabel. Lower case — it sits mid-sentence, unlike the dialog title.

tabSupportedSitesText.message: Open a supported site to find a Skill or Subagent.

tabUrlLabel.message: Paste a Tool link from a {}
tabUrlLabel.description: Label above the URL field. {} is replaced with a link that lists the supported sites.

tabUrlUnsupported.message: That link does not point to a skill or subagent.

tabOpenCollection.description: Link on the install confirmation that opens the installed-here list in settings.

tabCollectionEmpty.message: Nothing yet. Browse GitHub or skills.sh, or paste a link above.

tabUnverified.message: Not checked — folder access has expired, so this may already be gone.
tabUnverified.description: Shown on a collected row whose folder cannot be read.

tabRemoveChanged.message: $NAME$ changed after it was installed, so it was left alone. Remove it yourself if you meant to.

tabAutoOpenToggle.message: Open this popup when a skill is found

settingsTitle.message: Choose where Agent Tool can write

settingsSaved.message: Agent Tool can now write to $PATH$.

pickerIntroMac.message: Hidden folders start with a dot. Press Cmd+Shift+. in the picker to show $PATH$.

pickerIntroLinux.message: Hidden folders start with a dot. Press Ctrl+H in the picker to show $PATH$.

pickerIntroWindows.message: Hidden folders start with a dot, such as $PATH$.

pickerWrongFolder.message: You chose $NAME$. Choose $CONFIG$ itself — the folder name is the only thing this extension can check.

pickerUnavailable.message: This browser did not open the folder picker. The File System Access API looks turned off, and the extension cannot write anywhere without it.
pickerUnavailable.description: Shown when showDirectoryPicker is missing or refuses to open.

pickerUnavailableBrave.message: Brave turns the File System Access API off by default. Type brave://flags in the address bar (links to it do not open), search for “File System”, set that flag to Enabled, and relaunch Brave. If your version has no such flag, use Chrome or Edge instead.

permissionLost.message: Folder access expired. Try again to grant it.

errorTooLarge.message: The download went over the size limit and was stopped.

errorRollbackTooLarge.message: $PATH$ is already there and is too large to hold in memory while it is replaced, so nothing was changed. Remove it yourself, or pick another destination.

errorNotFound.message: That skill was not found in the repository.

errorFetchFailed.message: The download failed. Check your connection and try again.

errorBlocked.message: $PATH$ is already taken by something this extension cannot open — most likely a link made by the Agent Tool IDE extension, which means you already have it. To reinstall, remove it from the IDE extension first, or pick another destination.

errorUnusableName.message: $NAME$ cannot be used as a file name on every system (Windows rejects it), so this was not installed. Nothing on disk was changed.
errorUnusableName.description: Shown when an archive contains a name the file system cannot take.

rootMismatch.message: $EXPECTED$ is expected, but $CHOSEN$ is set. Choose $EXPECTED$ to install here.

tabIndexLead.message: Install them one at a time.

tabPermissionNote.message: Choose $CONFIG$. Agent Tool writes this item only inside $TARGET$. Your browser exposes only the folder name, so the full path cannot be verified.

tabPermissionNoteReady.message: Agent Tool writes this item only inside $TARGET$. Your browser exposes only the folder name, so the full path cannot be verified.

tabSecuritySource.message: $REPO$ is resolved as a public GitHub source.

tabSecurityPaths.message: Unsafe archive paths and links inside this item are rejected before writing.

tabSecurityRollback.message: Existing content is backed up within a bounded rollback budget before replacement.

badgeRateLimited.message: GitHub API rate limit reached. The skill list here could not be read — try again in a while.
badgeRateLimited.description: Tooltip shown on the toolbar icon when the browser extension hit GitHub's unauthenticated rate limit while listing skills.
